transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because... well, people at work have been complaining. I'm an artist, and lately, my artist statements and client notes are apparently confusing. I guess when I'm in meetings, I start talking about textures, and then budgets, and then... other things. Secret meanings, I suppose. They keep telling me they can't follow what I'm trying to explain. So, they told me to come here.
Could you tell me more about what you mean by those secret meanings?

Um... it's just... sometimes I notice things. Like a certain stain, or a seam... or specific phrases in emails from the galleries. It just feels like they are meant specifically for me. Like they're instructions, or... warnings about my work. 

People at work try to show me that it's just a normal email, or a normal mark, and they give me an ordinary explanation for it, but... it's really hard for me to let it go. I don't really like talking about it.
Aside from noticing these signs, have you ever heard voices or sounds when no one else was around?

Um... yeah. Sometimes. 

When I'm by myself in the studio... I'll hear this woman. She's just... quietly commenting from behind the shelves. Or sometimes I'll smell hot metal by an unfinished piece. It feels completely real to me, but... then I go check, and there's nothing there. 

I don't really know what else to say about it.
Have you ever had times where you felt unusually high, elated, or on top of the world, unlike your normal self?

I guess so, yeah. Sometimes. 

There are stretches where... I just feel really lit up. Like I'm unstoppable, and every idea I have for a piece is just brilliant. But... it doesn't always stay like that. Sometimes, if someone at the gallery makes even a small comment, I just... snap at them. It feels like a huge deal in the moment, even if it's not. 

I don't know. It's just how I get sometimes.
Do you ever experience the voices or secret signs during times when your mood feels completely normal?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. 

There was a month... maybe a little while ago, where I felt mostly okay. I was sleeping fine, and I didn't have that... lit up feeling. But... I was still hearing the woman behind the shelves. And I still felt like there were warnings in the materials I was using. 

That went on for... a few weeks, I guess. Even though my mood was fine. I don't really know why.
Looking back over the whole time you've had these experiences, have those high mood periods been present for most of that time, or only a small part of it?

I mean... I guess if I really think about it... those times where I'm all wired and irritable... they probably take up more of the year than the calm parts. It goes up and down, but... yeah. It's mostly been like that.
